insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure compatibility with the new tax recalculation behavior. They should also test their implementations to verify correct tax calculations. The orderUpdate mutation now returns an updated order object with recalculated taxes. Developers can use the GraphQL Admin API to test and verify the new behavior.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses for unfulfilled orders. This change improves the overall accuracy of order totals and reduces potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid revenue losses and ensure compliance with tax regulations. This update helps maintain the integrity of Shopify's tax calculation system.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving order management capabilities.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it easier for developers to achieve the Built for Shopify badge.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context and trust when making decisions about collaborator access.

themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enables more informed decision-making for merchants.

themes.title: Storefront and Inventory Updates
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed. Additionally, WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.

themes.title: Development Tools and Updates
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This update improves the development experience for Shopify app developers.
